title: SandboxLaunchProfile
description: The launch configuration of one Pix sandbox: what the next launch or relaunch of the sandbox installs and how Belai runs on it. A field left out inherits the product default. The sandbox is bought in the console and never created here; one sandbox has one launch configuration, so a document for a sandbox adopts it. Applying a change marks the sandbox for relaunch. The egress mode is SandboxEgressPolicy's; model providers, provisioning and models keep their own console pages. Only an owner or admin can change it. Deleting the document resets every field it manages to inherit.

packs.description: The tool packs installed, at most 32. An empty list installs none; left out, the product default packs.

name.description: The package name in its registry.

registry.description: Where the package comes from. Left out, nixpkgs.

version.description: The version wanted. Left out, the registry's current one.

checksum.description: The expected content hash, as the registry states it (sha256-...).

image.description: The machine image, pinned by digest (registry/name@sha256:<64 hex>), never a tag. Left out, the product default image.

notes.description: Free notes for the sandbox's owners, one line of at most 2000 characters.

webControls.description: Let a browser session control Belai (belai rc --web-controls).

webGuardrailsOff.description: Let a browser session turn the guardrails off. Needs webControls on.

webProjectSettings.description: Let a browser session change project settings.

classifier.description: The decision model Belai uses: clef, jev, or tev1 (used only while the sandbox's provider keys include Together AI).

versionPolicy.description: Which versions of installed packages a launch aims at. Left out, none is set.

pins.description: Versions pinned by nixpkgs attribute, at most 100. The pinned strategy needs at least one.

sandboxId.description: The sandbox, by its id (a lower-case UUID), as the console's sandbox page shows it.
